req.title: Reject limit above cap
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the limit parameter exceeds the maximum allowed.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should return an HTTP 422 status code when the 'limit' parameter exceeds the maximum allowed value. This is a validation requirement, and the test suite should cover positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure robust validation logic. The positive case will test a valid limit, the negative case will test an invalid limit exceeding the maximum, and the boundary case will test the limit at its maximum value.

tests.name: test_valid_limit
preconditions: The FastAPI application is running in-process.
actions: Send a GET request to /tasks/ with a valid limit parameter (e.g., 500).
expected: The response contains a list of tasks.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.get('/tasks/?limit=500')
assert response.status_code == 200
assert isinstance(response.json(), list)

tests.name: test_limit_above_maximum
preconditions: The FastAPI application is running in-process.
actions: Send a GET request to /tasks/ with a limit parameter exceeding the maximum allowed (e.g., 1001).
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.get('/tasks/?limit=1001')
assert response.status_code == 422
